_notes: All values in mm. Screws: ISO 273 medium clearance, ISO coarse tap drill, ISO 4762 socket-head dimensions. Counterbore = head + tool clearance. Insert values are typical for Ruthex-style tapered inserts; confirm against your vendor's datasheet before relying on them. All hardware dimensions are unverified starting values; measure the actual part or consult its manufacturer.

fits._source: Mirrors the CLAUDE.md clearance table (per-side, mm). Uncalibrated starting values.

print_rules._source: Mirrors the CLAUDE.md printer block and the harness overhang gate. Engineering features (library/engineering.py) derive their bounds from these.

_intent.nozzle: nozzle diameter; the smallest wall is min_wall_perimeters of these
_intent.min_wall_perimeters: two perimeters is the thinnest wall that prints solid
_intent.self_supporting_deg: slope from vertical for every printed slope; 1 deg inside the 45 deg gate so float noise cannot tip it into the support bucket
_intent.overhang_tolerance_mm2: unsupported area a feature may add before it is refused: tessellation noise and sub-nozzle slivers such as a faded thread tip, not a design allowance
_intent.layer_height: layer height of the profile's standard process (printer_profiles slicer process '0.20mm Standard'); vertical resolution of any relief
_intent.texture_min_lines: extrusion lines across the narrowest texture feature (ridge, groove, stud gap, letter stroke); one line smears or detaches, two hold
_intent.texture_min_layers: layers in the shallowest texture relief; one layer reads as a seam, not a texture
_intent.texture_max_aspect: deepest relief as a multiple of its feature width; taller, thinner ridges wobble and string
_intent.texture_brep_max_cells: texture cells kept as real B-rep geometry; past this the booleans get slow and the STEP heavy, so the texture is applied to the mesh at export instead
_intent.text_stroke_share: stroke width of the default sans font as a share of its font size; sets the smallest legible text from the minimum feature width

brief_constants._source: Values an eval brief pins without declaring them as params, so the design can't take them from PARAMS.

design_constants._source: A design's own choices that its brief does not pin. The lint keeps literals out of design files, so they live here, each with its intent.

_intent.steps: outward steps in the wall; 2 keeps each step over 1 mm so it reads as a ring, not a layer seam
_intent.step_overhang_deg: step face overhang from vertical; 1 deg inside the 45 deg gate so every step lands in the printable bucket
_intent.band_ratio: each band is this share of the one below (golden ratio), so the steps gather toward the rim
_intent.max_run_share: total step run as a share of the rim radius; past this the steps exceed the 15% overhang budget on small, tall pots
_intent.saucer_clearance: groove depth: lifts the drain outlet above standing saucer water (~3 mm)
_intent.groove_bridge: groove width: the bridge printed over each groove; short enough to bridge cleanly
_intent.drain_grooves: radial grooves from the drain to the foot edge, evenly spaced
_intent.foot_chamfer: bottom outer edge chamfer, one nozzle width, against first-layer flare on the saucer edge

nuts._source: ISO 4032 hex nuts: width across flats and height. Unverified starting values.
